title: "Goalkeepers"
page-layout: custom
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: build-gk-payload
#| results: asis

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(jsonlite)
})

data_dir <- "data"
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)

primary_gk_path  <- "C:/Users/iflem/Documents/Work/GK_App/data/master_gk_payload.qs2"
fallback_gk_path <- file.path(data_dir, "master_gk_payload.qs2")

if (file.exists(primary_gk_path)) {
  file.copy(primary_gk_path, fallback_gk_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  master_payload <- qs2::qs_read(primary_gk_path)
} else if (file.exists(fallback_gk_path)) {
  master_payload <- qs2::qs_read(fallback_gk_path)
} else {
  stop("master_gk_payload.qs2 not found.")
}

gk_mapping  <- master_payload$gk_mapping
shot_stream <- master_payload$gk_shot_stream
gk_match_log <- master_payload$gk_match_log
gk_cq_splits <- master_payload$gk_cq_splits

# Global reference baselines matching gk_app/app.R
global_cq_avgs <- gk_cq_splits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cq_bin) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    avg_sv_pct = round(1 - (sum(goals_allowed, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(sum(shots_faced, na.rm = TRUE), 1)), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

global_gp_avg <- gk_match_log %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    avg_gp_10xgot = round((sum(match_gp, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(sum(match_xgot, na.rm = TRUE), 0.1)) * 10, 4),
    avg_axa_pct   = round((sum(match_gp > 0, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(dplyr::n(), 1)) * 100, 2)
  )

global_max_gp <- max(abs(gk_match_log$match_gp), na.rm = TRUE)
if (is.infinite(global_max_gp) || is.na(global_max_gp)) global_max_gp <- 3.0
global_max_gp <- round(global_max_gp, 3)

global_avg_xgot <- round(sum(gk_match_log$match_xgot, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(sum(gk_cq_splits$shots_faced, na.rm = TRUE), 1), 4)

# Pre-compute League-level CQ & GP benchmarks for O(1) lookup in SAVE Profile
keeper_leagues <- gk_mapping %>% dplyr::select(keeper_id, league_id) %>% dplyr::distinct()

league_cq_table <- gk_cq_splits %>%
  dplyr::left_join(keeper_leagues, by = "keeper_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(league_id)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(league_id, cq_bin) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    shots = sum(shots_faced, na.rm = TRUE),
    goals = sum(goals_allowed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

league_gp_table <- gk_match_log %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(league_id)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(league_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_gp   = round(sum(match_gp, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    sum_xgot = round(sum(match_xgot, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    pos_cnt  = sum(match_gp > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    tot_cnt  = dplyr::n(),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

# Retain every shot (up to 300 frames per keeper) so the slider steps through consecutive 1, 2, 3... shot numbers
stream_anim <- shot_stream %>%
  dplyr::group_by(keeper_id) %>%
  dplyr::slice(unique(round(seq(1, dplyr::n(), length.out = min(dplyr::n(), 300))))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    date_str = stringr::str_match(stat_label, "<b>Date:</b> (.*?)<br>")[, 2],
    cum_xgot = as.numeric(stringr::str_match(stat_label, "<b>Expected Goals \\(xGOT\\):</b> ([0-9.]+)")[, 2]),
    post_mu  = round(post_mu, 4),
    post_sd  = round(post_sd, 4),
    cum_gp   = round(cum_goals_prevented, 2)
  )

stream_by_gk <- split(
  stream_anim %>% dplyr::select(s = shot_num, m = post_mu, sd = post_sd, gp = cum_gp, x = cum_xgot, d = date_str),
  stream_anim$keeper_id
)
stream_by_gk <- lapply(stream_by_gk, function(df) {
  list(s = df$s, m = df$m, sd = df$sd, gp = df$gp, x = df$x, d = df$d)
})

matches_clean <- gk_match_log %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    keeper_id = keeper_id,
    d  = as.character(match_date),
    df = ifelse(is.na(match_date), "Unknown Date", format(as.Date(match_date), "%b %d, %Y")),
    x  = round(match_xgot, 2),
    g  = as.integer(match_goals),
    gp = round(match_gp, 2)
  )
matches_by_gk <- split(matches_clean %>% dplyr::select(-keeper_id), matches_clean$keeper_id)
matches_by_gk <- lapply(matches_by_gk, function(df) {
  list(d = df$d, df = df$df, x = df$x, g = df$g, gp = df$gp)
})

cq_clean <- gk_cq_splits %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    keeper_id = keeper_id,
    b  = as.character(cq_bin),
    sf = as.integer(shots_faced),
    ga = as.integer(goals_allowed),
    sv = round(sv_pct, 4)
  )
cq_by_gk <- split(cq_clean %>% dplyr::select(-keeper_id), cq_clean$keeper_id)

mapping_clean <- gk_mapping %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    keeper_id     = as.character(keeper_id),
    league_id     = as.numeric(league_id),
    player_name   = as.character(player_name),
    team_name     = as.character(team_name),
    age           = ifelse(is.na(age), NA_real_, round(as.numeric(age))),
    total_minutes = round(as.numeric(total_minutes))
  )

payload <- list(
  globals = list(
    cq_avgs    = global_cq_avgs,
    gp_avg     = global_gp_avg,
    max_gp     = global_max_gp,
    avg_xgot   = global_avg_xgot
  ),
  league_cq = league_cq_table,
  league_gp = league_gp_table,
  mapping   = mapping_clean,
  stream    = stream_by_gk,
  matches   = matches_by_gk,
  cq        = cq_by_gk
)

cat(sprintf(
  "\n```{=html}\n<script id=\"gk-app-payload\" type=\"application/json\">%s</script>\n```\n",
  jsonlite::toJSON(payload, dataframe = "columns", auto_unbox = TRUE)
))
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  const LEAGUE_CHOICES = [
    { label: "All Leagues", value: "all" },
    { label: "NWSL (USA)", value: "9134" },
    { label: "USL Super League (USA)", value: "28384" },
    { label: "NCAA Division I (USA)", value: "18944" },
    { label: "WSL (ENG)", value: "9227" },
    { label: "WSL2 (ENG)", value: "10553" },
    { label: "Liga F (ESP)", value: "1127" },
    { label: "Premi\u00e8re Ligue (FRA)", value: "9677" },
    { label: "Frauen-Bundesliga (GER)", value: "232" },
    { label: "Serie A (ITA)", value: "10640" },
    { label: "Damallsvenskan (SWE)", value: "214" },
    { label: "Elitettan (SWE)", value: "19860" },
    { label: "Kvindeliga (DEN)", value: "9412" },
    { label: "Campeonato Nacional (POR)", value: "10527" },
    { label: "Besta deild kvenna (ISL)", value: "10307" },
    { label: "Toppserien (NOR)", value: "201" },
    { label: "Kansallinen Liiga (FIN)", value: "1662" },
    { label: "SWPL 1 (SCO)", value: "2054" },
    { label: "Brasileir\u00e3o S\u00e9rie A1 (BRA)", value: "10257" },
    { label: "Liga MX Femenil (MEX)", value: "13593" },
    { label: "WE-League (JPN)", value: "18653" },
    { label: "A-League (AUS)", value: "9495" },
    { label: "UEFA Women's Champions League", value: "696" },
    { label: "Senior International Matches", value: "intl" },
    { label: "FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup", value: "804" },
    { label: "FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup", value: "827" }
  ];

  const INTL_SET = new Set([3076, 852, 1954, 780, 20378, 477, 878, 437, 290, 32833, 18681, 9558, 11330, 1692, 404]);

  const rawPayload = document.getElementById("gk-app-payload").textContent;
  const payload = JSON.parse(rawPayload);

  function normSearch(str) {
    return String(str || "")
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .toLowerCase();
  }

  function colsToRows(colObj) {
    if (!colObj) return [];
    const keys = Object.keys(colObj);
    if (keys.length === 0) return [];
    const n = Array.isArray(colObj[keys[0]]) ? colObj[keys[0]].length : 1;
    const rows = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const r = {};
      for (let k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
        const key = keys[k];
        r[key] = Array.isArray(colObj[key]) ? colObj[key][i] : colObj[key];
      }
      r._norm = normSearch(r.player_name);
      rows[i] = r;
    }
    return rows;
  }

  const mappingRows  = colsToRows(payload.mapping);
  const leagueCqRows = colsToRows(payload.league_cq);
  const leagueGpRows = colsToRows(payload.league_gp);
  const globalCqRows = colsToRows(payload.globals.cq_avgs);
  const globalGpRow  = colsToRows(payload.globals.gp_avg)[0] || { avg_gp_10xgot: 0, avg_axa_pct: 50 };
  const globalMaxGp  = Number(payload.globals.max_gp) || 3.0;
  const globalAvgXgot = Number(payload.globals.avg_xgot) || 0.25;

  const streamMap  = payload.stream || {};
  const matchesMap = payload.matches || {};
  const cqMap      = payload.cq || {};

  // Registry of searchable goalkeeper comboboxes
  const comboRegistry = {};

  const N_GRID = 400;
  const X_SEQ = new Array(N_GRID);
  const PRIOR_Y = new Array(N_GRID);
  const INV_SQRT_2PI = 1 / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI);

  function dnorm(x, mu, sd) {
    const z = (x - mu) / sd;
    return (INV_SQRT_2PI / sd) * Math.exp(-0.5 * z * z);
  }

  function pnorm(x, mu, sd) {
    const z = (x - mu) / (sd * Math.SQRT2);
    const t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * Math.abs(z));
    const a1 = 0.254829592, a2 = -0.284496736, a3 = 1.421413741, a4 = -1.453152027, a5 = 1.061405429;
    const erf = 1 - (((((a5 * t + a4) * t) + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * Math.exp(-z * z);
    const sign = z < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    return 0.5 * (1 + sign * erf);
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < N_GRID; i++) {
    const x = -0.2 + (0.4 * i) / (N_GRID - 1);
    X_SEQ[i] = x;
    PRIOR_Y[i] = dnorm(x, 0.0, 0.036);
  }

  function getBlueShade(val, minVal = 0, maxVal = 100) {
    const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min((val - minVal) / Math.max(maxVal - minVal, 1), 1));
    let r, g, b;
    if (pct <= 0.5) {
      const t = pct * 2;
      r = Math.round(189 + t * (49 - 189));
      g = Math.round(215 + t * (130 - 215));
      b = Math.round(231 + t * (189 - 231));
    } else {
      const t = (pct - 0.5) * 2;
      r = Math.round(49 + t * (8 - 49));
      g = Math.round(130 + t * (81 - 130));
      b = Math.round(189 + t * (156 - 189));
    }
    return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
  }

  function toArr(v) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) return [];
    return Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v];
  }

  function formatSigned(val, digits) {
    const n = Number(val) || 0;
    return (n >= 0 ? "+" : "") + n.toFixed(digits);
  }

  function buildStatLabel(dateStr, shotNum, cumXgot, cumGp, postMu, postSd) {
    const avgQual = cumXgot / Math.max(shotNum, 1);
    const qualDiff = avgQual - globalAvgXgot;
    const credLower = postMu - 1.96 * postSd;
    const credUpper = postMu + 1.96 * postSd;
    return `<b>Date:</b> ${dateStr}<br><b>Shots Against:</b> ${shotNum}<br><b>Expected Goals (xGOT):</b> ${cumXgot.toFixed(2)}<br><b>Average xGOT:</b> ${avgQual.toFixed(2)} (${formatSigned(qualDiff, 2)} vs Global)<br><b>Goals Prevented:</b> ${formatSigned(cumGp, 2)}<br><b>Talent Estimate:</b> ${formatSigned(postMu, 2)}<br><b>95% Credible Interval:</b> [${formatSigned(credLower, 2)}, ${formatSigned(credUpper, 2)}]`;
  }

  function getFilteredKeepers(leagueFilterVal) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < mappingRows.length; i++) {
      const row = mappingRows[i];
      const lid = Number(row.league_id);
      let match = false;
      if (leagueFilterVal === "all") match = true;
      else if (leagueFilterVal === "intl") match = INTL_SET.has(lid);
      else match = (lid === Number(leagueFilterVal));

      if (match && !seen.has(row.keeper_id)) {
        seen.add(row.keeper_id);
        out.push(row);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function getKeeperMeta(keeperId) {
    return mappingRows.find(r => String(r.keeper_id) === String(keeperId)) || null;
  }

  function populateLeagueSelect(selectId) {
    const sel = document.getElementById(selectId);
    sel.innerHTML = "";
    LEAGUE_CHOICES.forEach(ch => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = ch.value;
      opt.textContent = ch.label;
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }

  function setupSearchableCombo(baseId, onSelectCallback) {
    const hiddenEl = document.getElementById(baseId);
    const inputEl  = document.getElementById(baseId + "_search");
    const menuEl   = document.getElementById(baseId + "_menu");
    const wrapEl   = document.getElementById("wrap_" + baseId);

    const state = {
      items: [],
      filtered: [],
      selectedId: "",
      selectedLabel: "",
      highlightIdx: 0
    };

    function renderMenu(queryStr) {
      const q = normSearch(queryStr);
      state.filtered = q
        ? state.items.filter(k => k._norm.includes(q))
        : state.items;

      menuEl.innerHTML = "";
      if (state.filtered.length === 0) {
        const empty = document.createElement("div");
        empty.className = "gk-search-empty";
        empty.textContent = "No matching goalkeepers";
        menuEl.appendChild(empty);
        return;
      }

      state.highlightIdx = Math.max(0, state.filtered.findIndex(k => String(k.keeper_id) === String(state.selectedId)));

      state.filtered.forEach((k, idx) => {
        const div = document.createElement("div");
        div.className = "gk-search-option" + (idx === state.highlightIdx ? " active" : "");
        div.textContent = k.player_name;
        div.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          selectKeeper(k.keeper_id, k.player_name, true);
          closeMenu();
        });
        menuEl.appendChild(div);
      });

      const activeNode = menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx];
      if (activeNode) activeNode.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
    }

    function selectKeeper(id, name, triggerCallback) {
      state.selectedId = String(id);
      state.selectedLabel = String(name);
      hiddenEl.value = state.selectedId;
      inputEl.value = state.selectedLabel;
      if (triggerCallback && onSelectCallback) onSelectCallback();
    }

    function openMenu() {
      Object.keys(comboRegistry).forEach(k => {
        if (k !== baseId) comboRegistry[k].closeMenu();
      });
      inputEl.value = "";
      renderMenu("");
      menuEl.classList.add("open");
    }

    function closeMenu() {
      menuEl.classList.remove("open");
      inputEl.value = state.selectedLabel;
    }

    inputEl.addEventListener("focus", () => {
      openMenu();
    });

    inputEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (!menuEl.classList.contains("open")) openMenu();
    });

    inputEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
      if (!menuEl.classList.contains("open")) menuEl.classList.add("open");
      renderMenu(inputEl.value);
    });

    inputEl.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (!menuEl.classList.contains("open")) return;
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (state.filtered.length > 0) {
          state.highlightIdx = Math.min(state.highlightIdx + 1, state.filtered.length - 1);
          Array.from(menuEl.children).forEach((c, i) => c.classList.toggle("active", i === state.highlightIdx));
          if (menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx]) menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
        }
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (state.filtered.length > 0) {
          state.highlightIdx = Math.max(state.highlightIdx - 1, 0);
          Array.from(menuEl.children).forEach((c, i) => c.classList.toggle("active", i === state.highlightIdx));
          if (menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx]) menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
        }
      } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (state.filtered.length > 0 && state.filtered[state.highlightIdx]) {
          const picked = state.filtered[state.highlightIdx];
          selectKeeper(picked.keeper_id, picked.player_name, true);
          closeMenu();
          inputEl.blur();
        }
      } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
        closeMenu();
        inputEl.blur();
      }
    });

    wrapEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

    comboRegistry[baseId] = {
      setItems: function(keepers, defaultIndex) {
        state.items = keepers;
        const existing = keepers.find(k => String(k.keeper_id) === String(state.selectedId));
        if (existing) {
          selectKeeper(existing.keeper_id, existing.player_name, false);
        } else if (keepers.length > 0) {
          const idx = Math.min(defaultIndex || 0, keepers.length - 1);
          selectKeeper(keepers[idx].keeper_id, keepers[idx].player_name, false);
        } else {
          selectKeeper("", "", false);
        }
      },
      closeMenu: closeMenu
    };
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", () => {
    Object.keys(comboRegistry).forEach(k => comboRegistry[k].closeMenu());
  });

  function updateKeeperSelect(leagueSelectId, gkSelectId, defaultIndex = 0) {
    const leagueVal = document.getElementById(leagueSelectId).value;
    const keepers = getFilteredKeepers(leagueVal);
    if (comboRegistry[gkSelectId]) {
      comboRegistry[gkSelectId].setItems(keepers, defaultIndex);
    }
  }

  // --- TAB 1: ANIMATED POSTERIOR PLOT ---
  function renderPosteriorPlot() {
    const gkId = document.getElementById("gk_select").value;
    const st = streamMap[gkId];
    if (!st) return;

    const sArr  = toArr(st.s);
    const muArr = toArr(st.m);
    const sdArr = toArr(st.sd);
    const gpArr = toArr(st.gp);
    const xArr  = toArr(st.x);
    const dArr  = toArr(st.d);

    const nFrames = sArr.length;
    if (nFrames === 0) return;

    const meta = getKeeperMeta(gkId);
    const selectedName = (meta && meta.player_name) ? meta.player_name : "Goalkeeper";

    let maxY = 5.0;
    const frameCurves = new Array(nFrames);
    const peakYs = new Array(nFrames);
    const statLabels = new Array(nFrames);

    for (let f = 0; f < nFrames; f++) {
      const mu = Number(muArr[f]);
      const sd = Number(sdArr[f]);
      const yVec = new Array(N_GRID);
      for (let i = 0; i < N_GRID; i++) {
        const yVal = dnorm(X_SEQ[i], mu, sd);
        yVec[i] = yVal;
        if (yVal > maxY) maxY = yVal;
      }
      frameCurves[f] = yVec;
      peakYs[f] = dnorm(mu, mu, sd);
      statLabels[f] = buildStatLabel(dArr[f] || "Unknown Date", Number(sArr[f]), Number(xArr[f] || 0), Number(gpArr[f] || 0), mu, sd);
    }

    const yLimit = Math.max(maxY * 1.2, 5.0);
    const frameDur = Math.max(18, Math.min(65, Math.round(3200 / Math.max(nFrames, 1))));

    const initIdx = 0;
    const initMu = Number(muArr[initIdx]);

    const traces = [
      {
        x: [initMu, initMu],
        y: [0, peakYs[initIdx]],
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "lines",
        line: { color: "#00747A", dash: "dot", width: 2 },
        hoverinfo: "none",
        showlegend: false
      },
      {
        x: X_SEQ,
        y: PRIOR_Y,
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "lines",
        line: { color: "#666666", dash: "dash", width: 2 },
        fill: "tozeroy",
        fillcolor: "rgba(136,136,136,0.2)",
        name: "Global xG Model Baseline",
        hoverinfo: "none",
        showlegend: false
      },
      {
        x: X_SEQ,
        y: frameCurves[initIdx],
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "lines",
        line: { color: "#00747A", width: 3 },
        fill: "tozeroy",
        fillcolor: "rgba(0,116,122,0.4)",
        name: "Keeper's Live Estimate",
        hoverinfo: "none",
        showlegend: false
      },
      {
        x: [-0.145],
        y: [yLimit * 0.70],
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "text",
        text: [statLabels[initIdx]],
        textposition: "middle right",
        textfont: { family: "Assistant", size: 14, color: "#111111" },
        hoverinfo: "none",
        showlegend: false
      }
    ];

    const frames = new Array(nFrames);
    const sliderSteps = new Array(nFrames);

    for (let f = 0; f < nFrames; f++) {
      const fName = String(sArr[f]);
      const mu = Number(muArr[f]);
      frames[f] = {
        name: fName,
        data: [
          { x: [mu, mu], y: [0, peakYs[f]] },
          { x: X_SEQ, y: frameCurves[f] },
          { x: [-0.145], y: [yLimit * 0.70], text: [statLabels[f]] }
        ],
        traces: [0, 2, 3]
      };

      sliderSteps[f] = {
        label: fName,
        method: "animate",
        args: [[fName], { mode: "immediate", frame: { duration: frameDur, redraw: false }, transition: { duration: frameDur } }]
      };
    }

    const layout = {
      title: {
        text: `<b>${selectedName} | Shotstopping Performance</b><br><sup>Grey = Global xG Model Baseline | Teal = Live Keeper Estimate</sup>`,
        font: { family: "Assistant", size: 18 }
      },
      margin: { t: 90, b: 110, l: 55, r: 50 },
      xaxis: {
        title: "<b>True Talent Estimate (Goals Prevented per Shot)</b><br>\u2190 Below Average | Elite Shotstopper \u2192",
        range: [-0.15, 0.15],
        tickvals: [-0.15, -0.10, -0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15],
        ticktext: ["-0.150", "-0.100", "-0.050", "0.000", "+0.050", "+0.100", "+0.150"],
        zeroline: false
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: "Certainty (Density)",
        range: [0, yLimit],
        showgrid: false,
        zeroline: false
      },
      showlegend: false,
      font: { family: "Assistant" },
      updatemenus: [{
        type: "buttons",
        showactive: false,
        x: 0,
        y: -0.22,
        xanchor: "left",
        yanchor: "top",
        direction: "left",
        pad: { t: 0, r: 10 },
        buttons: [
          {
            label: "Play",
            method: "animate",
            args: [null, { fromcurrent: true, frame: { duration: frameDur, redraw: false }, transition: { duration: frameDur } }]
          },
          {
            label: "Pause",
            method: "animate",
            args: [[null], { mode: "immediate", frame: { duration: 0, redraw: false }, transition: { duration: 0 } }]
          }
        ]
      }],
      sliders: [{
        active: 0,
        steps: sliderSteps,
        x: 0.12,
        len: 0.88,
        y: -0.20,
        xanchor: "left",
        yanchor: "top",
        currentvalue: {
          visible: true,
          prefix: "Timeline: Shot ",
          xanchor: "right",
          font: { color: "#00747A", size: 14, family: "Assistant" }
        },
        transition: { duration: frameDur }
      }]
    };

    const el = document.getElementById("gk_posterior_plot");
    Plotly.purge(el);
    Plotly.newPlot(el, traces, layout, { displayModeBar: false, responsive: true }).then(() => {
      Plotly.addFrames(el, frames);
    });
  }

  // --- TAB 2: HEAD-TO-HEAD COMPARISON PLOT ---
  function renderCompPlot() {
    const gkA = document.getElementById("comp_gk_a").value;
    const gkB = document.getElementById("comp_gk_b").value;
    if (!gkA || !gkB) return;

    const stA = streamMap[gkA];
    const stB = streamMap[gkB];
    if (!stA || !stB) return;

    const sA = toArr(stA.s), muA = toArr(stA.m), sdA = toArr(stA.sd), gpA = toArr(stA.gp);
    const sB = toArr(stB.s), muB = toArr(stB.m), sdB = toArr(stB.sd), gpB = toArr(stB.gp);

    const idxA = sA.length - 1;
    const idxB = sB.length - 1;
    if (idxA < 0 || idxB < 0) return;

    const fMuA = Number(muA[idxA]), fSdA = Number(sdA[idxA]), fShotsA = Number(sA[idxA]), fGpA = Number(gpA[idxA]);
    const fMuB = Number(muB[idxB]), fSdB = Number(sdB[idxB]), fShotsB = Number(sB[idxB]), fGpB = Number(gpB[idxB]);

    const metaA = getKeeperMeta(gkA);
    const metaB = getKeeperMeta(gkB);
    const nameA = (metaA && metaA.player_name) ? metaA.player_name : "Goalkeeper A";
    const nameB = (metaB && metaB.player_name) ? metaB.player_name : "Goalkeeper B";

    const yA = new Array(N_GRID);
    const yB = new Array(N_GRID);
    let maxY = 5.0;

    for (let i = 0; i < N_GRID; i++) {
      yA[i] = dnorm(X_SEQ[i], fMuA, fSdA);
      yB[i] = dnorm(X_SEQ[i], fMuB, fSdB);
      if (yA[i] > maxY) maxY = yA[i];
      if (yB[i] > maxY) maxY = yB[i];
    }

    const yLimit = Math.max(maxY * 1.2, 5.0);

    const labelA = `<b>${nameA}</b><br>Shots Faced: ${fShotsA}<br>Goals Prevented: ${formatSigned(fGpA, 2)}<br>Talent Est: ${formatSigned(fMuA, 2)}`;
    const labelB = `<b>${nameB}</b><br>Shots Faced: ${fShotsB}<br>Goals Prevented: ${formatSigned(fGpB, 2)}<br>Talent Est: ${formatSigned(fMuB, 2)}`;

    const diffSd = Math.sqrt(fSdA * fSdA + fSdB * fSdB);
    const probA = (1 - pnorm(0, fMuA - fMuB, diffSd)) * 100;
    const probCaption = (probA >= 50)
      ? `<i>${nameA} is ${probA.toFixed(1)}% likely to be a better true shotstopper than ${nameB}.</i>`
      : `<i>${nameB} is ${(100 - probA).toFixed(1)}% likely to be a better true shotstopper than ${nameA}.</i>`;

    const traces = [
      {
        x: X_SEQ, y: yA, type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
        line: { color: "#00747A", width: 3 },
        fill: "tozeroy", fillcolor: "rgba(0,116,122,0.4)",
        name: nameA, hoverinfo: "none"
      },
      {
        x: X_SEQ, y: yB, type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
        line: { color: "#D6604D", width: 3 },
        fill: "tozeroy", fillcolor: "rgba(214,96,77,0.4)",
        name: nameB, hoverinfo: "none"
      },
      {
        x: [fMuA, fMuA], y: [0, dnorm(fMuA, fMuA, fSdA)],
        type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
        line: { color: "#00747A", dash: "dot", width: 2 },
        showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "none"
      },
      {
        x: [fMuB, fMuB], y: [0, dnorm(fMuB, fMuB, fSdB)],
        type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
        line: { color: "#D6604D", dash: "dot", width: 2 },
        showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "none"
      },
      {
        x: [-0.145], y: [yLimit * 0.88],
        type: "scatter", mode: "text", text: [labelA],
        textposition: "middle right",
        textfont: { family: "Assistant", size: 13, color: "#00747A" },
        showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "none"
      },
      {
        x: [-0.145], y: [yLimit * 0.60],
        type: "scatter", mode: "text", text: [labelB],
        textposition: "middle right",
        textfont: { family: "Assistant", size: 13, color: "#D6604D" },
        showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "none"
      }
    ];

    const layout = {
      title: {
        text: "<b>Goalkeeper Head-to-Head Comparison</b><br><sup>Final Posterior Distributions</sup>",
        font: { family: "Assistant", size: 18 }
      },
      margin: { t: 90, b: 170, l: 55, r: 50 },
      xaxis: {
        title: "<b>True Talent Estimate (Goals Prevented per Shot)</b><br>\u2190 Below Average | Elite Shotstopper \u2192",
        range: [-0.15, 0.15],
        tickvals: [-0.15, -0.10, -0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15],
        ticktext: ["-0.150", "-0.100", "-0.050", "0.000", "+0.050", "+0.100", "+0.150"],
        zeroline: false
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: "Certainty (Density)",
        range: [0, yLimit],
        showgrid: false,
        zeroline: false
      },
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0.5, xanchor: "center", y: -0.22, yanchor: "top" },
      annotations: [{
        x: 0.5, y: -0.38, xref: "paper", yref: "paper",
        text: probCaption, showarrow: false,
        font: { family: "Assistant", size: 13, color: "#555555" }
      }],
      font: { family: "Assistant" }
    };

    Plotly.react("gk_comp_plot", traces, layout, { displayModeBar: false, responsive: true });
  }

  // --- TAB 3: SAVE PROFILE DASHBOARD ---
  function renderSaveProfile() {
    const gkId = document.getElementById("save_gk").value;
    const saveLeague = document.getElementById("save_league").value;
    if (!gkId) return;

    const meta = getKeeperMeta(gkId);
    if (!meta) return;

    const demoEl = document.getElementById("save_demographics_ui");
    const ageStr = (meta.age === null || meta.age === undefined || isNaN(meta.age)) ? "N/A" : Math.round(meta.age);
    demoEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="save-demo-grid">
        <div style="line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 10px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">
          <span style="color:#AAAAAA; font-size:13px;">Player</span><br>
          <span style="font-size:24px; font-weight:bold; color:#FFFFFF;">${String(meta.player_name).toUpperCase()}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 20px; white-space: nowrap;">
          <span style="color:#AAAAAA; font-size:13px;">Age:</span>
          <span style="font-size:18px; font-weight:bold; color:#FFFFFF;"> ${ageStr}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 20px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">
          <span style="color:#AAAAAA; font-size:13px;">Team:</span>
          <span style="font-size:18px; font-weight:bold; color:#FFFFFF;"> ${String(meta.team_name).toUpperCase()}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    const mLog = matchesMap[gkId] || { d: [], df: [], x: [], g: [], gp: [] };
    const mDates = toArr(mLog.d);
    const mDatesFmt = toArr(mLog.df);
    const mXgot = toArr(mLog.x).map(Number);
    const mGp = toArr(mLog.gp).map(Number);

    const cqRaw = cqMap[gkId] || { b: [], sf: [], ga: [], sv: [] };
    const cqBins = toArr(cqRaw.b);
    const cqSf   = toArr(cqRaw.sf).map(Number);
    const cqSv   = toArr(cqRaw.sv).map(Number);

    const getSplit = (binName) => {
      const idx = cqBins.indexOf(binName);
      return idx >= 0 ? { sf: cqSf[idx], sv: cqSv[idx] } : { sf: 0, sv: 0 };
    };

    const lowSplit  = getSplit("Low");
    const medSplit  = getSplit("Medium");
    const highSplit = getSplit("High");

    const totalMinutes = Math.max(Number(meta.total_minutes) || 1, 1);
    const p90Factor = 90 / totalMinutes;

    const totalShots = lowSplit.sf + medSplit.sf + highSplit.sf;
    const totalXgot  = mXgot.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

    const shotsP90 = totalShots * p90Factor;
    const xgotP90  = totalXgot * p90Factor;
    const lowP90   = lowSplit.sf * p90Factor;
    const medP90   = medSplit.sf * p90Factor;
    const highP90  = highSplit.sf * p90Factor;

    const drawTotal = (totalShots / Math.max(totalShots, 200)) * 100;
    const drawShots = (shotsP90 / Math.max(shotsP90, 8)) * 100;
    const drawXgot  = (xgotP90 / Math.max(xgotP90, 2.5)) * 100;
    const drawHigh  = (highP90 / Math.max(shotsP90, 8)) * 100;
    const drawMed   = (medP90 / Math.max(shotsP90, 8)) * 100;
    const drawLow   = (lowP90 / Math.max(shotsP90, 8)) * 100;

    // 1. Volume Plot
    const yLabelsVol = ["xGOT/90", "CQ Mix/90", "Shots/90", "Total Shots"];
    const barW = 0.4;

    const volTraces = [
      {
        x: [0, 0, 0, drawTotal], y: yLabelsVol, type: "bar", orientation: "h", width: barW,
        marker: { color: getBlueShade(drawTotal) }, hoverinfo: "text", hoverlabel: { align: "left" },
        hovertext: ["", "", "", `<b>Total Shots: ${totalShots.toFixed(0)}</b><br>Absolute volume of non-penalty shots faced.`]
      },
      {
        x: [0, 0, drawShots, 0], y: yLabelsVol, type: "bar", orientation: "h", width: barW,
        marker: { color: getBlueShade(drawShots) }, hoverinfo: "text", hoverlabel: { align: "left" },
        hovertext: ["", "", `<b>Shots/90: ${shotsP90.toFixed(2)}</b><br>Non-penalty shots faced per 90 minutes.`, ""]
      },
      {
        x: [0, drawHigh, 0, 0], y: yLabelsVol, type: "bar", orientation: "h", width: barW,
        marker: { color: "#E34A33" }, hoverinfo: "text", hoverlabel: { align: "left" },
        hovertext: ["", `<b>High CQ/90: ${highP90.toFixed(2)}</b><br>Shots > 0.35 xGOT per 90.`, "", ""]
      },
      {
        x: [0, drawMed, 0, 0], y: yLabelsVol, type: "bar", orientation: "h", width: barW,
        marker: { color: "#FD8D3C" }, hoverinfo: "text", hoverlabel: { align: "left" },
        hovertext: ["", `<b>Medium CQ/90: ${medP90.toFixed(2)}</b><br>Shots between 0.11 - 0.35 xGOT per 90.`, "", ""]
      },
      {
        x: [0, drawLow, 0, 0], y: yLabelsVol, type: "bar", orientation: "h", width: barW,
        marker: { color: "#FEB24C" }, hoverinfo: "text", hoverlabel: { align: "left" },
        hovertext: ["", `<b>Low CQ/90: ${lowP90.toFixed(2)}</b><br>Shots \u2264 0.10 xGOT per 90.`, "", ""]
      },
      {
        x: [drawXgot, 0, 0, 0], y: yLabelsVol, type: "bar", orientation: "h", width: barW,
        marker: { color: getBlueShade(drawXgot) }, hoverinfo: "text", hoverlabel: { align: "left" },
        hovertext: [`<b>xGOT/90: ${xgotP90.toFixed(2)}</b><br>Expected Goals on Target faced per 90 minutes.`, "", "", ""]
      }
    ];

    const volLayout = {
      barmode: "stack", showlegend: false,
      paper_bgcolor: "#E6E6E6", plot_bgcolor: "#E6E6E6",
      xaxis: { title: "", showgrid: false, zeroline: false, showticklabels: false, range: [0, 100] },
      yaxis: { title: "", showgrid: true, gridcolor: "#FFFFFF", gridwidth: 2, showticklabels: false, categoryorder: "array", categoryarray: yLabelsVol },
      margin: { l: 10, r: 20, t: 10, b: 10 },
      annotations: [
        {
          x: drawTotal >= 28 ? 2 : drawTotal + 1.5, y: "Total Shots",
          text: `<b>Total Shots: ${totalShots.toFixed(0)}</b>`, showarrow: false, xanchor: "left",
          font: { size: 13, color: drawTotal >= 28 ? "#FFFFFF" : "#1D3549", family: "Assistant" }
        },
        {
          x: drawShots >= 28 ? 2 : drawShots + 1.5, y: "Shots/90",
          text: `<b>Shots/90: ${shotsP90.toFixed(2)}</b>`, showarrow: false, xanchor: "left",
          font: { size: 13, color: drawShots >= 28 ? "#FFFFFF" : "#1D3549", family: "Assistant" }
        },
        {
          x: drawXgot >= 28 ? 2 : drawXgot + 1.5, y: "xGOT/90",
          text: `<b>xGOT/90: ${xgotP90.toFixed(2)}</b>`, showarrow: false, xanchor: "left",
          font: { size: 13, color: drawXgot >= 28 ? "#FFFFFF" : "#1D3549", family: "Assistant" }
        },
        {
          x: drawHigh / 2, y: "CQ Mix/90",
          text: drawHigh >= 8 ? `<b>HD: ${highP90.toFixed(1)}</b>` : "",
          showarrow: false, font: { color: "#FFFFFF", size: 12, family: "Assistant" }
        },
        {
          x: drawHigh + (drawMed / 2), y: "CQ Mix/90",
          text: drawMed >= 8 ? `<b>MD: ${medP90.toFixed(1)}</b>` : "",
          showarrow: false, font: { color: "#111111", size: 12, family: "Assistant" }
        },
        {
          x: drawHigh + drawMed + (drawLow / 2), y: "CQ Mix/90",
          text: drawLow >= 8 ? `<b>LD: ${lowP90.toFixed(1)}</b>` : "",
          showarrow: false, font: { color: "#111111", size: 12, family: "Assistant" }
        }
      ]
    };

    Plotly.react("save_vol_plot", volTraces, volLayout, { displayModeBar: false, responsive: true });

    const isTargetLeague = (lid) => {
      const nLid = Number(lid);
      if (saveLeague === "intl") return INTL_SET.has(nLid);
      if (saveLeague !== "all") return nLid === Number(saveLeague);
      return nLid === Number(meta.league_id);
    };

    // 2. Save Percentage by CQ Tier Plot
    const binsOrder = ["Low", "Medium", "High"];
    const labelsOrder = ["LDSv%", "MDSv%", "HDSv%"];
    const svValues = [];
    const lgSvValues = [];
    const glSvValues = [];
    const svColors = [];
    const svTooltips = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const bName = binsOrder[i];
      const lbl = labelsOrder[i];
      const sp = getSplit(bName);
      const gkSv = (sp.sv || 0) * 100;

      const glRow = globalCqRows.find(r => r.cq_bin === bName);
      const glSv = glRow ? Number(glRow.avg_sv_pct) * 100 : 50;

      let lgShots = 0, lgGoals = 0;
      leagueCqRows.forEach(r => {
        if (r.cq_bin === bName && isTargetLeague(r.league_id)) {
          lgShots += Number(r.shots);
          lgGoals += Number(r.goals);
        }
      });
      const lgSv = lgShots > 0 ? (1 - lgGoals / lgShots) * 100 : glSv;

      svValues.push(gkSv);
      lgSvValues.push(lgSv);
      glSvValues.push(glSv);
      svColors.push(getBlueShade(gkSv));
      svTooltips.push(`<b>${lbl}: ${gkSv.toFixed(1)}%</b><br>League Average: ${lgSv.toFixed(1)}%<br>Global Average: ${glSv.toFixed(1)}%<br>Save percentage for this Chance Quality tier.`);
    }

    const svShapes = [0, 1, 2].map(i => ({
      type: "line",
      x0: lgSvValues[i], x1: lgSvValues[i],
      y0: i - barW / 2, y1: i + barW / 2,
      line: { color: "#333333", width: 3 }
    }));

    const svAnnotations = [0, 1, 2].map(i => {
      const val = svValues[i];
      const isWide = val >= 28;
      return {
        x: isWide ? 2 : Math.max(val, 0) + 1.5,
        y: labelsOrder[i],
        text: `<b>${labelsOrder[i]}: ${val.toFixed(1)}</b>`,
        showarrow: false, xanchor: "left",
        font: { color: isWide ? "#FFFFFF" : "#1D3549", size: 13, family: "Assistant" }
      };
    });
    svAnnotations.push({
      x: (lgSvValues[0] || 50) + 2,
      y: -0.3,
      text: "Lg Avg",
      showarrow: false, xanchor: "left",
      font: { size: 12, color: "#555555", family: "Assistant" }
    });

    const svTrace = [{
      x: svValues, y: labelsOrder, type: "bar", orientation: "h", width: barW,
      marker: { color: svColors }, hoverinfo: "text", hoverlabel: { align: "left" }, hovertext: svTooltips
    }];

    const svLayout = {
      shapes: svShapes, showlegend: false,
      paper_bgcolor: "#E6E6E6", plot_bgcolor: "#E6E6E6",
      xaxis: { title: "", showgrid: false, zeroline: false, showticklabels: false, range: [0, 100] },
      yaxis: { title: "", showgrid: true, gridcolor: "#FFFFFF", gridwidth: 2, showticklabels: false, categoryorder: "array", categoryarray: labelsOrder },
      margin: { l: 10, r: 20, t: 10, b: 10 },
      annotations: svAnnotations
    };

    Plotly.react("save_sv_plot", svTrace, svLayout, { displayModeBar: false, responsive: true });

    // 3. Value & Consistency Plot (AxA% & GP/10xGOT)
    let lgSumGp = 0, lgSumXgot = 0, lgPosCnt = 0, lgTotCnt = 0;
    leagueGpRows.forEach(r => {
      if (isTargetLeague(r.league_id)) {
        lgSumGp   += Number(r.sum_gp);
        lgSumXgot += Number(r.sum_xgot);
        lgPosCnt  += Number(r.pos_cnt);
        lgTotCnt  += Number(r.tot_cnt);
      }
    });

    const refGp10 = lgTotCnt > 0 ? (lgSumGp / Math.max(lgSumXgot, 0.1)) * 10 : Number(globalGpRow.avg_gp_10xgot);
    const refAxa  = lgTotCnt > 0 ? (lgPosCnt / Math.max(lgTotCnt, 1)) * 100 : Number(globalGpRow.avg_axa_pct);

    const sumMatchGp = mGp.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const gp10Xgot   = (sumMatchGp / Math.max(totalXgot, 0.1)) * 10;
    const posMatches = mGp.filter(v => v > 0).length;
    const axaPct     = (posMatches / Math.max(mGp.length, 1)) * 100;

    const visGp    = Math.min(Math.max((gp10Xgot + 5) * 10, 0), 100);
    const visAvgGp = Math.min(Math.max((refGp10 + 5) * 10, 0), 100);
    const valLabels = ["AxA%", "GP/10xGOT"];

    const valShapes = [
      { type: "line", x0: refAxa, x1: refAxa, y0: -barW / 2, y1: barW / 2, line: { color: "#333333", width: 3 } },
      { type: "line", x0: visAvgGp, x1: visAvgGp, y0: 1 - barW / 2, y1: 1 + barW / 2, line: { color: "#333333", width: 3 } }
    ];

    const valTooltips = [
      `<b>AxA%: ${axaPct.toFixed(1)}%</b><br>League Average: ${refAxa.toFixed(1)}%<br>Global Average: ${Number(globalGpRow.avg_axa_pct).toFixed(1)}%<br>Above Expected Appearance %.<br>Percentage of matches where Goals Prevented > 0.`,
      `<b>GP/10xGOT: ${formatSigned(gp10Xgot, 3)}</b><br>League Average: ${formatSigned(refGp10, 3)}<br>Global Average: ${formatSigned(globalGpRow.avg_gp_10xgot, 3)}<br>Goals Prevented per 10 xGOT faced.`
    ];

    const valTrace = [{
      x: [axaPct, visGp], y: valLabels, type: "bar", orientation: "h", width: barW,
      marker: { color: [getBlueShade(axaPct), getBlueShade(visGp)] },
      hoverinfo: "text", hoverlabel: { align: "left" }, hovertext: valTooltips
    }];

    const valLayout = {
      shapes: valShapes, showlegend: false,
      paper_bgcolor: "#E6E6E6", plot_bgcolor: "#E6E6E6",
      xaxis: { title: "", showgrid: false, zeroline: false, showticklabels: false, range: [0, 100] },
      yaxis: { title: "", showgrid: true, gridcolor: "#FFFFFF", gridwidth: 2, showticklabels: false, categoryorder: "array", categoryarray: valLabels },
      margin: { l: 10, r: 20, t: 10, b: 0 },
      annotations: [
        {
          x: axaPct >= 28 ? 2 : axaPct + 1.5, y: "AxA%",
          text: `<b>AxA%: ${axaPct.toFixed(1)}</b>`, showarrow: false, xanchor: "left",
          font: { color: axaPct >= 28 ? "#FFFFFF" : "#1D3549", size: 13, family: "Assistant" }
        },
        {
          x: visGp >= 35 ? 2 : visGp + 1.5, y: "GP/10xGOT",
          text: `<b>GP/10xGOT: ${formatSigned(gp10Xgot, 3)}</b>`, showarrow: false, xanchor: "left",
          font: { color: visGp >= 35 ? "#FFFFFF" : "#1D3549", size: 13, family: "Assistant" }
        }
      ]
    };

    Plotly.react("save_val_plot", valTrace, valLayout, { displayModeBar: false, responsive: true });

    // 4. Game-by-Game Form Plot
    const formColors = mGp.map(v => v > 0 ? "#3182BD" : "#DE2D26");
    const formTooltips = mGp.map((v, idx) =>
      `<b>Date:</b> ${mDatesFmt[idx] || mDates[idx]}<br><b>Goals Prevented:</b> ${formatSigned(v, 2)}<br><b>Match xGOT:</b> ${Number(mXgot[idx]).toFixed(2)}`
    );

    const formTrace = [{
      x: mDates, y: mGp, type: "bar",
      marker: { color: formColors },
      width: 86400000 * 4,
      hoverinfo: "text", hoverlabel: { align: "left" }, hovertext: formTooltips
    }];

    const formLayout = {
      showlegend: false,
      paper_bgcolor: "#E6E6E6", plot_bgcolor: "#E6E6E6",
      xaxis: { title: "", showgrid: false, tickfont: { family: "Assistant", size: 12, color: "#555555" } },
      yaxis: {
        title: "",
        range: [-globalMaxGp * 1.05, globalMaxGp * 1.05],
        showgrid: true, gridcolor: "#FFFFFF", gridwidth: 2,
        zeroline: true, zerolinecolor: "#333333", zerolinewidth: 2,
        tickfont: { family: "Assistant", size: 12, color: "#555555" }
      },
      margin: { t: 5, b: 22, l: 32, r: 20 }
    };

    Plotly.react("save_form_plot", formTrace, formLayout, { displayModeBar: false, responsive: true });
    scaleDashboard();
  }

  function scaleDashboard() {
    const wrapper = document.getElementById("save_scale_wrapper");
    const dash = document.getElementById("save_dashboard_export_area");
    if (wrapper && dash && wrapper.clientWidth > 0) {
      const scale = wrapper.clientWidth / 1280;
      if (scale < 1) {
        dash.style.transform = `scale(${scale})`;
        wrapper.style.height = `${720 * scale}px`;
      } else {
        dash.style.transform = "none";
        wrapper.style.height = "720px";
      }
    }
  }

  window.switchGkTab = function(tab) {
    document.getElementById("gk-panel-post").style.display = (tab === "post") ? "grid" : "none";
    document.getElementById("gk-panel-comp").style.display = (tab === "comp") ? "grid" : "none";
    document.getElementById("gk-panel-save").style.display = (tab === "save") ? "grid" : "none";

    document.getElementById("gk-tab-btn-post").classList.toggle("active", tab === "post");
    document.getElementById("gk-tab-btn-comp").classList.toggle("active", tab === "comp");
    document.getElementById("gk-tab-btn-save").classList.toggle("active", tab === "save");

    if (tab === "post") renderPosteriorPlot();
    else if (tab === "comp") renderCompPlot();
    else if (tab === "save") {
      renderSaveProfile();
      setTimeout(scaleDashboard, 80);
    }
  };

  function initGkApp() {
    ["league_filter", "comp_league_a", "comp_league_b", "save_league"].forEach(populateLeagueSelect);

    setupSearchableCombo("gk_select", renderPosteriorPlot);
    setupSearchableCombo("comp_gk_a", renderCompPlot);
    setupSearchableCombo("comp_gk_b", renderCompPlot);
    setupSearchableCombo("save_gk", renderSaveProfile);

    updateKeeperSelect("league_filter", "gk_select", 0);
    updateKeeperSelect("comp_league_a", "comp_gk_a", 0);
    updateKeeperSelect("comp_league_b", "comp_gk_b", 1);
    updateKeeperSelect("save_league", "save_gk", 0);

    document.getElementById("league_filter").addEventListener("change", () => {
      updateKeeperSelect("league_filter", "gk_select", 0);
      renderPosteriorPlot();
    });

    document.getElementById("comp_league_a").addEventListener("change", () => {
      updateKeeperSelect("comp_league_a", "comp_gk_a", 0);
      renderCompPlot();
    });
    document.getElementById("comp_league_b").addEventListener("change", () => {
      updateKeeperSelect("comp_league_b", "comp_gk_b", 1);
      renderCompPlot();
    });

    document.getElementById("save_league").addEventListener("change", () => {
      updateKeeperSelect("save_league", "save_gk", 0);
      renderSaveProfile();
    });

    document.getElementById("download_plotly").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const el = document.getElementById("gk_posterior_plot");
      const origSliders = el.layout.sliders || [];
      const origMenus = el.layout.updatemenus || [];
      Plotly.relayout(el, { sliders: [], updatemenus: [] }).then(() => {
        return Plotly.downloadImage(el, { format: "png", width: 1200, height: 750, scale: 3, filename: "goalkeeper_posterior" });
      }).then(() => {
        Plotly.relayout(el, { sliders: origSliders, updatemenus: origMenus });
      });
    });

    document.getElementById("download_plotly_comp").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const el = document.getElementById("gk_comp_plot");
      Plotly.downloadImage(el, { format: "png", width: 1200, height: 750, scale: 3, filename: "goalkeeper_head_to_head_comparison" });
    });

    document.getElementById("download_save_dash").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const dash = document.getElementById("save_dashboard_export_area");
      const origTransform = dash.style.transform;
      dash.style.transform = "none";
      html2canvas(dash, { backgroundColor: "#1D3549", scale: 2 }).then(canvas => {
        dash.style.transform = origTransform;
        const link = document.createElement("a");
        link.download = "SAVE_Dashboard_Export.png";
        link.href = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
        link.click();
      });
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", scaleDashboard);

    renderPosteriorPlot();
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initGkApp);
  } else {
    initGkApp();
  }
})();
</script>
```
